::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8}
Hi, I'm Ron! I'm a graduate student in the **Master of Science in Digital Marketing (MSDM)** program at Cal Poly Pomona. I like working where data and storytelling meet: figuring out what the numbers say, then turning that into content people actually want to watch or read.

I work as a **Social Media & Marketing Assistant at Associated Students, Inc. (ASI)**, creating content for accounts with 20K+ combined followers, and I've interned in marketing at **Yamaha Corporation of America** and the **Ontario Jr Reign**. Right now I'm also on an MSDM capstone team helping a nonprofit client, **Wellness Ranch Therapy**, use its website data to reach more supporters.
:::

:::

## Personal Statement

I got into marketing through content: making videos, posts, and promo pieces that people actually stop and watch, from growing a junior hockey team's social following to producing Reels for campus programs. Graduate school showed me the other half of the job. Good content is only as useful as your ability to prove what it did. Now I like working on both sides: setting up the tracking, finding what the data says, and turning it into the next piece of content or the next decision.

I'm especially drawn to mission-driven work. Helping a small nonprofit figure out which visitors turn into supporters has shown me how much a clear analysis can matter when time and budget are tight. I'm looking for a role in digital marketing analytics where I can keep connecting the creative and the measurable.

## Current Capstone: Wellness Ranch Therapy

[Wellness Ranch Therapy](https://www.wellnessranchtherapy.org) is a nonprofit in Rancho Cucamonga that offers equine-assisted therapy. Our team is helping them grow their reach and donations through **website & SEO improvements, GA4 analytics, Google Ad Grants, and donor outreach**. Here's my part:

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card-box}
**📊 Measurement setup**

Helped set up and validate GA4 tracking so the organization can see which visits lead to inquiries, not just page views.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card-box}
**🔎 Baseline insights**

Early data showed **about half of visitors come from Instagram** and **nearly 9 in 10 browse on mobile**, which points to a social-first, mobile-first strategy.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card-box}
**📄 Content opportunities**

The homepage draws the most visits but the shortest attention, so it's the first place to add impact stats and a clear way to give.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card-box}
**💚 Donor outreach (my AO4)**

Leading donor-focused content, impact storytelling, and UTM-tracked outreach campaigns, then measuring their effect on donations.
:::
:::

:::

## Career Aspirations

I want to build a career in digital marketing analytics, helping brands and nonprofits make smarter decisions with their data. My goal is to be the person on a team who can set up the tracking, run the analysis, *and* explain the results in a way that leads to action. Long term, I'd love to help mission-driven organizations use their data to reach more of the people they serve.
